cases.title: Fully fluid layout
cases.description: The site scales smoothly at EVERY width 320-3200 — not just the two widths a designer drew. Undesigned widths (768, 1024, 1280, 1440) are clean interpolations, fixed with fluid/reflow rules, never fixed-px patches.

checklist.text: No horizontal overflow at any width (page never scrolls sideways)
No element wider than the viewport
Undesigned widths (768/1024/1280/1440) render unbroken, not desktop-squished
Layout scales proportionally (uses the --u unit / %, not fixed px)
No zero-height / collapsed sections at any width

cases.title: Fluid typography
cases.description: Type scales smoothly with the viewport (clamp), stays readable on the smallest phone and never grows absurd on a 4K screen; text never overflows its box.

checklist.text: Headings & body scale up between 320 and 1920 (fluid, not fixed size)
Body text stays >= ~14px at 320px (legible on a phone)
Headings don't balloon past the design intent on huge screens
No text overflows or is clipped by its container at any width
No awkward single-word wraps / broken headlines

cases.title: Fluid spacing & proportions
cases.description: Padding, margins and gaps scale with the viewport so the rhythm feels intentional at every width — never cramped on tablet or cavernous on desktop.

checklist.text: Section padding / gaps grow between 320 and 1920 (proportional --u)
No fixed-px gaps that look cramped at large widths
Text columns have a comfortable max line length (not full-bleed on desktop)
Vertical rhythm between sections stays consistent

cases.title: Reflow & stacking
cases.description: Multi-column layouts collapse to stacks at the right point; nav, grids and card rows reflow instead of squishing.

checklist.text: Card rows wrap/stack on narrow widths instead of shrinking to unreadable
The nav reflows / becomes a mobile menu on small widths
Mobile shows the real stacked layout, not desktop squeezed into a phone
Images resize with their column, keeping aspect ratio

cases.title: Matches the design — desktop (~1920)
cases.description: At the designed desktop width the built page matches the Figma frame: layout, section order, spacing, colours and type.

checklist.text: Section order & composition match the Figma frame
Spacing / alignment match the design at ~1920
Type sizes, weights and line-heights match the design
Colours match the design tokens (no off-palette values)

cases.title: Matches the design — mobile (~390)
cases.description: At the designed mobile width the built page matches the Figma mobile frame.

checklist.text: Mobile composition matches the Figma mobile frame
Stacking order matches the design
Tap targets are large enough (>= 44px) and not crowded

cases.title: Typography fidelity
cases.description: The intended fonts actually load and render — no silent fallback to a system font.

checklist.text: The design's fonts are loaded (not a fallback like Arial/system)
Required weights (e.g. 800/700/400) are available
No flash of unstyled / wrong font on load

cases.title: Imagery fidelity
cases.description: Images match the design: correct asset, right aspect ratio, crisp (not upscaled/blurry), not distorted.

checklist.text: No broken images
Rendered aspect ratio matches the source (no squashed/stretched images)
Images aren't upscaled beyond their natural size (no blur)
Every image has alt text

cases.title: Content completeness
cases.description: Everything the design shows is filled in — no placeholder, empty fields, or missing sections.

checklist.text: No empty headings / paragraphs / buttons
Every designed section is present and in order
No lorem / placeholder / TODO copy left in

cases.title: Assets & optimization
cases.description: Images and fonts are optimized so pages load fast — modern formats, responsive sizes, lazy loading, and no layout shift.

checklist.text: Every image has width & height set (no layout shift / CLS)
Below-the-fold images are lazy-loaded
Raster images ship responsive srcset / <picture> (webp/avif)
Images aren't served far larger than they render
Fonts are woff2 and preconnected/preloaded

cases.title: Code optimization & zero-JS
cases.description: Published output is lean: minified CSS, no client JavaScript, a single stylesheet, no dead code.

checklist.text: Published page ships no client-side <script> (zero-JS)
One minified stylesheet, not many blocking requests
No large inline style/script blocks
Total page weight stays within budget

cases.title: Box model — sizes, margins, paddings
cases.description: Spacing and sizing behave predictably everywhere: border-box, consistent scale, no fixed px that overflow.

checklist.text: box-sizing: border-box everywhere (padding never overflows width)
No fixed-px width/margin that overflows small viewports
Margins/paddings follow a consistent scale (no random values)
No negative-margin hacks that break at some width

cases.title: Flexbox & grid
cases.description: Flex/grid layouts wrap and align correctly at every width; no track overflow, no squished items.

checklist.text: No flex/grid item overflows its container/track
Rows wrap (flex-wrap / auto-fit) instead of overflowing
Gaps use gap, not margin hacks
Items align as designed (no accidental stretch/misalign)
Flex/grid children have min-width:0 so text can shrink (no blowout)

cases.title: Interactive elements
cases.description: Buttons, links, menus, accordions and carousels work, are reachable by keyboard, and have visible states — all zero-JS.

checklist.text: Every button/CTA has a destination or action (no dead buttons)
Interactive elements have visible hover AND focus states
Tap targets are >= 44px on mobile and not crowded
All interactive elements are keyboard-reachable (tab/enter)
Accordions/carousels/menus work without JavaScript (CSS / details)

cases.title: Editor = Preview (exact same source)
cases.description: What a marketer sees while editing is byte-identical to what publishes — same render, same media queries.

checklist.text: Tablet/Mobile render in a real iframe at that width (correct media queries)
Mobile layout stacks like the real site, not desktop-squished
The editor device view has no overflow the preview lacks
Style-override utilities ship in the export bundle

cases.title: Semantic tag editing
cases.description: Marketers change what an element means without changing how it looks.

checklist.text: The HTML tag actually changes (h1->h2, span->...)
Styling stays identical (size, colour, margin, weight)
Choices are constrained per element family (no nonsense tags)

cases.title: Bounded style edits
cases.description: Style controls apply safe, on-brand overrides and reset cleanly.

checklist.text: Alignment / weight / spacing / opacity apply on the canvas
Reset-to-design clears every override
Marketer mode offers no raw hex / arbitrary px
Builder mode unlocks free-form editing

cases.title: Translations (i18n)
cases.description: English is the source; any language can be translated per key with fallback.

checklist.text: A new language can be added
A translated key renders in that language on the canvas
Untranslated keys fall back to English
Editing a translation never changes the English source

cases.title: Content editing & autosave
cases.description: Text, images and links edit inline and persist.

checklist.text: Text edits apply and autosave
Undo reverts the last change; redo re-applies it
Repeat items add/remove within min-max

cases.title: SEO & headings
cases.description: Search-engine essentials hold on every published page.

checklist.text: Exactly one main title (<h1>) per page
Heading levels don't skip a step
The page has a <title>

cases.title: Accessibility
cases.description: Usable by everyone.

checklist.text: Every image has alt text
Every link has a destination (href)
Editor & site text meet contrast in their theme

cases.title: Screens & navigation
cases.description: Every screen and route loads without errors.

checklist.text: Home, projects API, previews and version routes respond
Dashboard, editor, preview, test overlay and export dialog render
No console or page errors in an editor session
